newsitem.title: GREECE: BARDOT KISS OF APPROVAL FOR GREEK MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: BARDOT KISS OF APPROVAL FOR GREEK MINISTER.

text.p: Brigitte Bardot, actress turned animal rights activist, on Thursday praised the role of Greek environment and agriculture officials in the protection of animals.

In an effusive mood, Bardot -- who has previously strongly criticised dog fights in Greece -- described environment undersecretary Theodore Kolliopanos as "very intelligent" and exchanged kisses with agriculture Stephanos Tzoumakas.
Kolliopanos said he spent an hour briefing Bardot on Greece's environmental protection programmes and efforts to protect the monk seal and loggerhead turtle.
